claims: The `GATE_TEST_FOCUS` guard misses no-lock gate runs — `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:601`: a real `--no-lock` run gets a green self-test having executed 1 of 11 families
Two comments assert the false premise and must move with the code: `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:595-597` ("every command a real gate run spawns carries it")
`docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1143-1145` also asserts the false premise and must move with the code

The partition verifier never checks `arm_suite_abort_trap` — `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:484-565`: a family added without the call runs with no ERR trap, yielding a bare nonzero exit with no `aborted: line N: …` line and no gate-output tail
The documented focused invocation isn't allowlisted — `.claude/settings.json:31-32`: the allowlist covers only the bare form, so agents likely hit a permission prompt on every focused run
(nit) `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1116` says "~9-minute suite" while the table below sums to ~11m36s
